Face Reference (STRICT — FACE ONLY)

Use the uploaded image only for facial identity and hairstyle.
Replace only the face. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, beard shape, skin tone, and hairstyle.
Do not beautify, stylize, age, or modify facial features in any way.

Scene & Concept

Create an ultra-realistic, hyper-detailed 8K luxury lifestyle fashion editorial portrait of a high-status man seated inside an upscale hotel café or private lounge.
The composition must intentionally include large native / negative space, a fully visible table, and visible legs, exactly like a premium editorial photograph.

Pose & Body Language (LOCKED – EXACT)

Subject is seated comfortably on a light-colored cushioned chair

White rectangular table fully visible in the foreground

One hand holding a modern premium smartphone, resting naturally above the table

Other hand placed on the handle of a white porcelain coffee cup, positioned on a saucer on the table

Light steam visible rising from the cup

Upper body upright, shoulders relaxed

Legs clearly visible under the table, relaxed seated position, no crossing

Head turned slightly to the side (not facing camera directly)

Gaze directed off-camera

Expression calm, confident, composed, quiet-luxury attitude

No dramatic gestures, no motion blur

Outfit & Accessories (FROZEN)

White ribbed turtleneck sweater, fine-gauge knit texture

Slim-fit white trousers, clean tailoring

Dark luxury sunglasses with thin metal frame

Minimalist high-end wristwatch with leather strap and brushed steel case

No logos, no branding, no color changes

Environment & Native Space Composition (VERY IMPORTANT)

Elegant luxury café / hotel lounge interior

Soft cream, beige, and white color palette

Large vertical window on one side creating strong natural negative space

Bright daylight entering through the window, forming a clean light column

Warm floor lamp clearly visible behind the subject, adding balance

Subject positioned slightly off-center

Ample empty space around head, shoulders, table edges, and sides

Table surface clean and uncluttered

Background softly blurred but spacious — not crowded

Composition feels airy, calm, premium, editorial

Lighting & Mood (LOCKED)

Soft natural daylight illuminating face, sweater, hands, table, and legs

Warm ambient lamp light adding depth behind the subject

Smooth shadow transitions, no harsh contrast

Subtle reflections on phone, watch, porcelain cup, and table

Quiet-luxury, old-money lifestyle mood

Image Style & Detail Quality

Ultra-realistic textures: ribbed knit fabric, skin detail, ceramic cup, steam, metal watch, smartphone finish

DSLR-style depth of field

High-end fashion editorial photography

Clean, magazine-ready composition

Aspect Ratio & Framing

Vertical 4:5

Face, hands, full table, legs, phone, and coffee cup all visible

Native / negative space intentionally preserved

No cropping, no tilt, no distortion

prompts.title: Pensive woman holding coffee
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image strictly as the ONLY face reference and preserve exact facial features, proportions, skin tone, and identity without any alteration. Create an aesthetic, cinematic close-up portrait of a young individual wearing a dark brown chunky knit sweater with a braided texture. The subject is positioned slightly right of center, body angled subtly toward the left, holding a dark brown takeaway cup with a black lid close to the face with both hands. Expression is calm, introspective, and softly focused, with gaze directed slightly off-camera.

Lighting is strong, warm, and directional from the left side, casting defined highlights on the face and sweater while creating deep, dramatic shadows on the opposite side. Subtle rim lighting gently outlines the hair and shoulders, enhancing separation from the background. The skin appears smooth and refined with a soft, natural porcelain finish (avoid over-plastic look, retain realistic texture).

Background features a dim, moody interior with large, wide-leaf indoor plants on both sides, partially illuminated by soft, diffused light from above, creating contrast between highlighted leaves and deep shadows. The wall behind shows distinct shadow patterns, enhancing the cinematic depth.

Color grading leans toward warm sepia/brown tones with a vintage, moody aesthetic. Shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh keeps sharp focus on the face and upper body while softly blurring the background. Details include dark brown nail polish and minimal rings on fingers.

Shot in portrait orientation, close-up framing (mid-chest to head), high dynamic range, ultra-high detail, soft cinematic contrast, 8K quality. Aspect ratio 4:5.
